content_of_post_to_comment:
I wrote about this before, but I recommend setting yourself three simple rules to start a digital minimalist journey:

1. No screens in bed or while eating.
2. If possible, put your phone on DND while sleeping or eating. You can configure your phone (Android at least) to ring on calls from specific numbers (e.g., family, boss) while on DND while silencing all other calls and notifications.
3. Eat only at a table. Sleep only in bed (given appropriate living space).

This creates screen-free spaces and fights the very unhealthy habits of eating in front of the TV, checking your phone while eating, falling asleep on a sofa in front of a screen, or having your sleep interrupted by phone notifications.
